build_AssociativeEmbeddingHead: build an AssociativeEmbeddingHead model for human pose estimation with configurable tag dimensions and keypoint losses
predict_AssociativeEmbeddingHead: predict keypoints and associative embedding tags from backbone features with optional flip and multiscale test-time augmentation
forward_AssociativeEmbeddingHead: forward multi-scale feature maps through the network to produce heatmaps and associative embedding tag outputs
loss_AssociativeEmbeddingHead: calculate combined keypoint MSE loss and associative embedding pull and push losses from predicted heatmaps and tags
flip_tags_AssociativeEmbeddingHead: flip tagging heatmaps horizontally using symmetric keypoint indices for test-time augmentation with optional heatmap shifting
